purpose: The OCR-APT (NT2102) demo attack: exploit react2shell (RCE) from a Kali VM, then run a compact MITRE ATT&CK chain on the target, observable via SilkETW Kernel-Process/File/Network and self-labelled.

attacker.input: the vulnerable web URL (e.g. http://10.21.2.10:3000); the pack is mounted on Kali at /opt/attack-pack (Vagrant)
attacker.note: react2shell's exact injection path/field is confirmed from C:\lab\react2shell at run time (launcher --exploit-path/--exploit-field), not baked in.

note: One scenario, custom steps only (no Atomic Red Team dependency). Whether its window reaches the SG-Det cut-off (one subgraph of ~>=30 anomalous nodes, DEVIATIONS D8) is confirmed on a capture, not tuned to the attack.

scenarios.delivery: Kali exploits react2shell; the RCE shell (node.exe -> powershell) fetches + runs this script
